question.problem:
Given that 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}],
$$

 express the quadratic form $Q(x)={x}_{1}^{2}+{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-2{x}_{2}^{2}\,$ in terms of the components of $y.$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that

$$
[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

  

gives the following expressions for ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & =5{y}_{1}+{y}_{2} \\ {x}_{2} & =-2{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we substitute these into our quadratic form expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}Q(x) & ={x}_{1}^{2}+{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-2{x}_{2}^{2} \\  & =(5{y}_{1}+{y}_{2})^{2}+(5{y}_{1}+{y}_{2})(-2{y}_{2})-2(-2{y}_{2})^{2} \\  & =25{y}_{1}^{2}+10{y}_{1}{y}_{2}+{y}_{2}^{2}-10{y}_{1}{y}_{2}-2{y}_{2}^{2}-8{y}_{2}^{2} \\  & =25{y}_{1}^{2}-9{y}_{2}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
